evidence.reason: The finding quotes an older revision where SHA_RE/DIGEST_RE/REQUEST_ID_RE/TARGET_RE/TS_RE ended with `$`. At the current tip the same file already defines all five patterns with `\Z` (lines 49-51, 54, 57), so a trailing newline is no longer accepted by `_sha`, `normalize_binding`, `_timestamp`, or the other validators. The history's first entry, bfaabe1d ("Tighten validators, pin diff format, ..."), is the tightening change that resolved this.
